#### （2）媒体发布

**官媒海外版（合并提炼）** ：

今日官媒海外版及国内主流媒体海外传播内容整体呈现正面基调，聚焦入境游市场复苏与消费升级。新华网报道"China Cool"现象火爆，折射中国入境游独特魅力；另有报道关注外国人在华体验"酷"暑假，低碳理念融入日常生活。中国网报道入境游市场正从观光打卡向沉浸式体验转型升级。中新网关注外国游客来上海体验"中国式时尚"，新浪财经报道上海南外滩量身定制中心多举措升级，让外国游客乐享"中国购"。此外，有境外社交账号转发北京入境游市场加速从纯观光向"观光+消费"多元化模式转型的内容。整体来看，官方媒体着力塑造中国作为新兴时尚消费目的地与沉浸式体验胜地的形象。[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9jSm5qTGFja3l1Q3l0TkVsMm1ZTEpYX0xleTJNTHEzMjk5bzh2QVNPUm5mbmw2bThfbVRmaWIwU0MxQWxwRWlaSW1pTXRrV3E3UjRaR25IOWlLUXRqQWVQdnJra05oNm1ud2pCUl9lWEphcHAwN19R?oc=5)｜[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE53SkdzNmVMYkliTjM3S0NUVExlTXU4MmRUVVR6VjY3UTE0NFBfVWRReDlfdGNjcWRXWUU0ZmtpWFZ0ck1yUFlOVDRZWHI2UTIzZXZoaDVKa3NDRE41X2gzcDZMWlItTVdnNzhEMEdjRGRNWDBDT3BFRzZEbkh2ZTg?oc=5)｜[中国网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE84SnJOSzNQU3d5c2V1OGxNSnB2aklhaHoxTFRKYlkyanJJV1JoRFIxU3Mzb2MtM0d4djluUDhZZTZLNFktYXFRR1dTZTZiY3lMWUVTaGtyR2ZzTWNicjNQaFZYVEtNMENMY0ZPV0FUSHQxWU0?oc=5)｜[chinanews.com.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE1XYU5JS1lQUVJZZU5ncHVLVS0tcGMwUEVYVV9jY2NEbkZpQ1pwQjloeTZNb0pyTmY1RGRfMnhhT3lTYUsxc0lJSExYYU45Sl9JeklnU1pmMEJ4cmZXS09Ra0FRUWdfNnRr?oc=5)｜[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE5zd1FJTHlhVi1DZHBOc3VtMmU5azctSGdHUXl4QUJWRmduWFdkT0Z0SVZVX2QxQWI4UE5RQndOam1aYjFBcHRvbjlVbU9xbk0wOFl5eUZEYjFrQ0NBa3BPM2VCaVUwN3NTZzJIcXQ4UVhSYzNyVFlRZQ?oc=5)｜[x.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBjd1k5VW1xUWRPOWVBWFBfRkk1bDhLLTkxa0xxMm5jOEx0blZZUkIzOTdDSmZTUXR0bVdxcV9CaTY2Z2NpQ1BMdHg1a3FvR0d2SjhVclBhS2Z1U0dJRGU4N0Rn?oc=5)
